initialFailure.cause: Agent build command set CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, omitting embedded Simulator entitlements. Real team re-signing alone cannot restore that identity. Both linked-note interactions passed their assertions but original cloud return showed nativeAuthentication and failed. Normal Xcode build restored embedded application/App Group identity and the existing session without login or session replacement. No product auth regression established.
initialFailure.additionalSetup: Initial source append/copy ran from the stage directory with root-relative paths and failed before changing source; build-v1 therefore used unchanged tests. Corrected paths copied source before build-v2.

signingToolChange.change: Before any signing, read embedded __TEXT/__entitlements from actual app/widget Mach-O binaries and require the exact isolated application identifier/team and App Group. Verify equality after signing. Existing real-team/strict-signature checks remain. Document Xcode signing must stay enabled.
